methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA signals intentional ecosystem-building to distribute AI literacy beyond corporate users, creating peer networks that could spread capability through community impact rather than concentrating in enterprise hubs.

signals.title: ‘Shaping our future’: Company powering AI data centers invests $50+ million in Henrico, adding 200 jobs - WWBT
signals.signal_reading: A $50M+ AI data center infrastructure investment in Henrico deepens Richmond's technical capability but signals concentration around capital-intensive facilities rather than distributed AI fluency—200 jobs likely require specialized skills unavailable to broader workforce.

signals.title: State invests $3M to help transform Hampton Roads into hub for aircraft technology and training - 13newsnow.com
signals.signal_reading: State investment to transform Hampton Roads into an aircraft technology hub represents concentrated capability-building in a defense-adjacent sector, but $3M scale and specialized domain suggest deep-but-narrow expertise rather than distributed AI literacy.

signals.title: Virginia's best-paying jobs are most exposed to AI, report says - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Virginia's best-paying jobs facing highest AI exposure reveals structural risk: those with resources to adapt may deepen advantages while workers in lower-wage roles lack access to reskilling, accelerating rather than closing capability divides.

signals.title: How Virginia became the world’s data center capital and how it’s going - Virginia Mercury
signals.signal_reading: Analysis of Virginia's data center capital status crystallizes the concentration dynamic—NoVA's infrastructure dominance deepens as physical AI infrastructure follows cheap power and existing network effects rather than distributing capability geographically.
